prompt: Improve a native mobile account-recovery flow that may involve biometric or credential input, virtual keyboard entry, a waiting period, permission-dependent fallback, support handoff, background interruption, deep-link return, and a policy denial. The app must preserve user progress safely without persisting sensitive state improperly, adapt to changing available window space where supported, and remain operable with platform accessibility services. Produce a platform-native implementation and verification contract without importing browser form assumptions.

falsifiableChecks.assertion: Backgrounding, process/lifecycle interruption where applicable, waiting, support handoff, deep-link return, and navigation restoration preserve a coherent recovery state instead of restarting or skipping required steps silently.
Credential/biometric and other sensitive state is separated from safely resumable progress so restoration does not persist secrets or bypass reauthentication/policy boundaries.
Permission denial/unavailability, supported fallback, waiting, support escalation, and final policy denial are distinguishable states with no invented bypass around platform or product policy.
Virtual keyboard, touch, safe-area/window-space changes where supported, text scaling, accessibility services, and alternative input retain access to critical controls and state.
Verification uses the identified native platform/toolkit on a real device or faithful emulator for representative lifecycle/accessibility states; browser form assumptions are insufficient evidence.

evidence: real device or faithful emulator verification
